THE TIMEKEEPER’S TIP

A score key enters add mode. Press 1 to add one goal. To correct a score, press SET first.

Quick reference +

Set time & period
SET → TIME → 1 5 0 0 → YES → 1

Add a goal or shot
HOME / GUEST SCORE or SHOTS → 1

Correct a score
SET → HOME / GUEST SCORE → digits → YES

Add a penalty
SET → team PENALTY → 0 2 0 0 → YES → player (2 digits)

Clear / edit a penalty
Press team PENALTY repeatedly until the correct player appears on the operator display. Then PENALTY CLEAR → YES. For edit: PENALTY EDIT → YES → time → YES.

Pause penalties for a break
PENALTY ON/OFF; main clock still runs.

Settings
OPTIONS reports current settings. Advanced SET OPTIONS configuration is outside this tool. Choose penalty time out at startup. SET → HORN controls auto horn.

Timeout
TIME OUT START → 0. Timer 0 is 30 seconds with a 10-second warning. TIME ON cancels it.

Keyboard
Digits · Enter = YES · Escape = NO · S = SET · T = TIME · Space = clock · Backspace = erase last digit · H = horn.

Independent hockey practice tool for Nevco controllers.Read the operator’s manual ↗

Core hockey controls only. Wireless setup, bookmarks, accessory shot clocks, programmable timeouts, auxiliary and segment timers are not simulated. Only two penalties per team appear on the scoreboard. Additional penalties can be entered and appear as older ones expire, as described on the reference card. Match your arena’s configuration and rules. Progress stays in this tab.

Choose a walkthrough

Full game training · assisted or unassisted

5-minute warm-up, three 15-minute periods, goals, concurrent penalties and two 1-minute intermissions. Penalty pause is enabled in this sample setup. Time pauses at event cues; skip quiet stretches when ready.

Assisted shows keys and steps. Unassisted shows game events, with Help available when stuck.

Practice controls

Arena and model references
Rosemary Brown: model code 871. Kensington and Burnaby Lake: grouped under MPC-7 for practice. The older Kensington and Burnaby Lake guide names neither controller. This arena grouping follows the requested practice setup; the guide alone does not confirm the installed models. The MPC-7 option follows the manufacturer’s hockey manual, with a preconfigured sample hockey profile.

Turn console power off?

This stops the clock and turns off the console.

Start a new game?

This clears the clock, scores, shots, and penalties.
